api.description: The backend the application talks to.

url.description: Complete address of the backend without a slash at the end, e.g. https://backend.et.localhost or http://localhost:8081/ezfBackend. The address of an endpoint is <url>/<endpoint>.

returnToMaxAgeMinutes.description: How long the address remembered before the login is valid, in minutes (default 10). A value above the validity of the status cookie of the backend login (10 minutes) brings nothing.

connection.description: What the application does when the backend does not answer. Every field is optional.

failuresBeforeWarning.description: How many failed connection tests in a row until the warning appears (default 1).

retryIntervalSeconds.description: Seconds between the end of one connection test and the start of the next, and how long a test waits for an answer (default 5).

logoutAfterSeconds.description: Seconds without a successful connection test, counted from the first failed one, until the application logs out locally (default 300).

banners.description: Settings for the banners that stand under the app bar.

maxVisible.description: How many banners are visible at the same time (default 20); further ones wait until one closes.
